import csv

from decimal import Decimal

def parse_invoice_002071(text):

    vendor = "Delta Studio Supply"

        'quantity': '3',

    # Page 2 items

def parse_invoice_002093(text):
    """Parse invoice 002093 - Firth Survey Services"""
    vendor = "Firth Survey Services"
    invoice_id = "002093"
    
    items = []
    
    # Page 1 items
    items.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'vendor': vendor,
        'description': 'Site survey, area 2',
        'quantity': '1',
        'unit_price': '448.50',
        'line_amount': '448.50'
    })
    
    items.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'vendor': vendor,
        'description': 'Travel time, route 2',
        'quantity': '2.25',
        'unit_price': '64.80',
        'line_amount': '145.80'
    })
    
    items.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'vendor': vendor,
        'description': 'Calibration standard, set 2',

    # Page 2 items

        'vendor': vendor,
        'description': 'Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2',
        'quantity': '1',
        'unit_price': '-26.00',
        'line_amount': '-26.00'
    })
    
    # Totals
    subtotal = Decimal('775.60')
    tax = Decimal('90.64')
    total = Decimal('866.26')
    
    return items, subtotal, tax, total


def main():
    # Parse all invoices
    items_002071, sub_002071, tax_002071, total_002071 = parse_invoice_002071(None)
    items_002082, sub_002082, tax_002082, total_002082 = parse_invoice_002082(None)
    items_002093, sub_002093, tax_002093, total_002093 = parse_invoice_002093(None)
    
    # Combine all items
    all_items = items_002071 + items_002082 + items_002093
    
    # Write items.csv
    with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(all_items)
    
    print(f"Created items.csv with {len(all_items)} line items")
    
    # Calculate reconciliation
    reconciliation = []
    
    for invoice_id, subtotal, tax, printed_total in [
        ('002071', sub_002071, tax_002071, total_002071),
        ('002082', sub_002082, tax_002082, total_002082),
        ('002093', sub_002093, tax_002093, total_002093)
    ]:
        # Compute total from subtotal + tax
        computed_total = subtotal + tax
        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
        
        reconciliation.append({
            'invoice_id': invoice_id,
            'subtotal': f'{subtotal:.2f}',
            'tax': f'{tax:.2f}',
            'printed_total': f'{printed_total:.2f}',
            'computed_total': f'{computed_total:.2f}',
            'difference': f'{difference:.2f}',
            'status': status
        })
        
        if status == 'discrepancy':
            print(f"DISCREPANCY in invoice {invoice_id}: difference = {difference:.2f}")
    
    # Write reconciliation.csv
    with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(reconciliation)
    
    print(f"Created reconciliation.csv with {len(reconciliation)} invoices")
    
    # Check for discrepancies
    discrepancies = [r for r in reconciliation if r['status'] == 'discrepancy']
    if discrepancies:
        print(f"\nFound {len(discrepancies)} discrepancy(ies)")
    else:
        print("\nAll invoices matched successfully")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
EOF
